'''Marthera''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].

==Activities== 
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split. 

During the [[Seanchan]] attack on the [[White Tower]], Marthera stands with [[Josaine]] and [[Adelorna Bastine]] to fight the invaders. The group is defeated within minutes (Josaine dies and Adelorna is forced to flee) and Marthera is taken captive by the Seanchan and gets an ''[[a'dam]]'' placed around her neck.
